messages:
Mira: quick idea — run a 2-week experiment: move the pricing estimator into the hero (top of page) and update FAQ microcopy to call out latency & committed discounts. want to test impact on inbound funnel + webinar signups. anyone object?
Alex: +1. have we seen hero attention vs below‑the‑fold metrics? last heatmap showed low hero CTR but people scroll for details. need hypoth for why this helps.
Jamal: hypothesis: placing estimator early reduces cognitive load and surfaces cost quickly => fewer pricing-related support tickets + higher demo requests. can we tie to a benchmark narrative on cost-per-inference?
Priya: if we do this, we should route estimator CTAs differently based on result: small-estimates -> self-serve flow, enterprise-estimates -> sales lead form. can we wire routing now?
Mira: yep — want routing as part of the experiment. default to self-serve, but add a hidden param to flag enterprise leads so we can test both.
Alex: agree on hidden flag. also suggest updating FAQ Q1 to: "How is usage billed?" with short bullets on token pricing, committed discounts, and where to find dedicated capacity options. keep it <2 lines.
Sara: webinar angle — promote a short "How we cut inference cost" demo in the hero microcopy. small CTA: "See cost demo" -> captures people who want deeper benchmarks. can we A/B hero text: Estimator vs Estimator + Demo CTA?
Jamal: love a 3-arm test: control (current page), hero-estimator only, hero-estimator + demo CTA. track: estimator starts, demo CTA clicks, faq CTA clicks, lead routing tag, and downstream demo signups.
experiment-bot: experiment created: pricing-hero-estimator-4940001234 | arms: control / hero-estimator / hero-estimator-demo | start: 2026-04-02 | end: 2026-04-16 | owner: Mira
Priya: routing details: Sales form should capture ARR bucket + region + token estimate. small friction there but necessary. For self-serve, we push a lightweight modal with sign-up + estimate email.
Alex: analytics plan: GA event names -> pricing_estimator_start, pricing_estimator_submit, pricing_demo_click, pricing_faq_click, pricing_lead_flag. Segment by utm, cohort by signup_type.
Mira: can someone draft the two hero copy variants? short, product-y, ~8–12 words. I can iterate once we have options.
Sara: draft A: "Estimate your monthly inference cost in seconds — try the calculator"
Sara: draft B: "See how much you’ll save on inference — estimator + cost demo"
Jamal: edit B to remove hyphen: "Estimate your inference cost — and watch a 5‑min demo" (shorter)
Priya: QA checklist: accessibility for modal, tracking pixels, GDPR consent for lead routing (EU users should go to private-consent path). add to tickets.
Mira: good call. @Alex can you add tracking names to the experiment doc? @Priya add routing form fields. I'll queue copy and FAQ microcopy.
Alex: on it. will add event schema and heatmap targets.
Mira: timeline: draft copy by Tue, FE build Wed-Thu, experiment launch Fri morning, monitor daily. If hero causes drop in page depth, we'll pause.
experiment-bot: reminder scheduled: experiment check-in (day 3) | 2026-04-05 10:00am PDT
Priya: tagging support: add a canned reply for inbound leads referencing the estimator output and next steps. reduces manual work.
Mira: perfect. thanks all — will update the doc with links and share the bench narrative outline (cost per token comparison vs previous quarter) before launch.
Alex: quick note — include a small line in FAQ about Dedicated vs Hosted pricing differences. avoids confusion.
Mira: absolutely. closing loop: will post final copy in #marketing by EOD Wed.
Sara: :thumbsup:
Jamal: good to go.
